components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; padding: 13px 28px; border: 1px solid #f4d68c; border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #ecc061, #d6a23e); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #9a7228, 0 8px 18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); color: #24180a; font: 600 17px/1.2 Cinzel, Marcellus, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-decoration: none; transition: filter 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e2b04a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 #9a7228, 0 3px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35); }

components.name: Quiet Button

narrative.overview: Evening in a questing town: the day's work posted in gold and ink, and the windows themselves the notices. The page is the game's own hour of rest, a steel-blue sky over umber earth, and on that ground stand OneMoreQuest's windows, large and lifted, as they stand over the world in the game. The pictures are the product: drawn from the game as the windows alone on a transparent ground, given the most room the page has. It is a fantasy game's page without a game company's assets.
keyCharacteristics: Dusk sky over umber earth; parchment for words, forged gold for what matters, ink on the closing parchment.
Cinzel's carved capitals for the name and headings, Marcellus's flared letters for everything read.
Screenshots as the architecture: a stage of 85rem against a reading column of 36rem.
Chapters, each opened by the one ornament: a gold rule with a diamond.
Lifted, never glowing: soft, offset, neutral shadows; light only as sky and horizon.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is for the name, headings, links and the primary plate. A paragraph is never gold; a background is never gold except the plate.

rules.name: The Sky Is Light Rule
rules.body: Blue appears only as the sky and its glow at the horizon, behind content, never on it.

rules.name: The Carved Shadow Rule
rules.body: Gold display type casts a short solid shadow straight down (0 2-3px 0, gold-shadow), as if cut into the page. It never glows.

rules.name: The rem Column Rule
rules.body: Reading widths are set in rem, not ch, so a large heading and the text under it share one left edge.

rules.name: The No Halo Rule
rules.body: No zero-offset coloured shadow, box or text. Depth is offset and neutral; light is a background.

dos: Do give screenshots the stage (85rem) and redraw them (bun run media) rather than enlarging a picture past half its pixels.
Do write alt text that describes the windows' content.
Do keep QuestieDB, the requirement, beside every way to get the addon.
Do set reading widths in rem (36rem) and keep body text at 18px, 4.5:1 or better.
Do credit QuestieDB and say that World of Warcraft belongs to Blizzard, once, in the footer.
donts: Don't use Blizzard's logos, fonts or extracted art; only the addon's own screenshots.
Don't add download counts, ratings or testimonials that do not exist.
Don't put a glow or zero-offset coloured shadow on anything (The No Halo Rule).
Don't use gold for paragraphs or backgrounds other than the primary plate (The One Gold Rule).
Don't set the page in rounded, equal SaaS cards or put an eyebrow label over a heading.
Don't add the diamond ornament anywhere but a chapter's opening.
